verdict.rationale: Cal.com's v2 REST API covers a broad slice of the UI surface: booking create and reschedule, slot queries, event types with custom booking fields, schedules, event-type webhooks, conferencing apps, round-robin configuration, and routing traces. It also markets an 'API-first architecture' and offers MCP and CLI access over the same capabilities. However, nothing documents true UI parity, and several UI features (workflows, routing-form authoring, payments setup, insights) have no evidenced API equivalent; the scheduling-configuration endpoint also rejects non-team event types. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or coverage matrix, API evidence for workflows, routing forms, payments and insights, a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
